request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply:
Official reports provide a few useful data points, but they do not establish a complete cross-ship comparison of first-of-class overruns:

- **Ford-class carrier CVN-78:** CRS reports a final procurement cost of **$13,316.5 million** in then-year dollars (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 7).
- **Constellation-class frigate FFG-62:** CRS gives the lead ship an estimated procurement cost of **$1,499.3 million** (CRS R44972, PDF p. 10). This is an estimate, not a final overrun figure.
- **First 10 FFG-62s:** CRS reports that a 2020 CBO analysis estimated these ships would cost **40% more** to build than Navy estimates (CRS R44972, PDF p. 39). This applies to the first 10 ships together, not just the lead ship.

The reviewed sources did not provide a comparable original-baseline-to-final-cost overrun for CVN-78 or an actual final cost for FFG-62. [Open the cited brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-163946-70f2.html).
reply.reasoning: The verified evidence contains a final lead-ship cost, a separate lead-ship estimate, and a multi-ship cost-growth estimate; it lacks comparable baseline-to-final overruns for those lead ships.
